Maya (marketing): Quick ask for the runtime team — we9re finalizing the webinar slide deck and need validated benchmark numbers for quantized variants. Can you run a small, reproducible sweep and drop logs + a one-paragraph summary? :pray:

Maya (marketing): Targets: open-13b:v2 float16 baseline, q4_0, q4_k_m, and int8. Use the marketing-100 prompt set + 20 QA prompts from product. Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput at concurrencies 4/8/16, and GPU util / tokens-per-sec. Include cold-start and warmed (2 warm requests) runs.

Jin (eng-runtime): Got it. We9ll tag it marketing/webinar/quant-1791234567. Quick clarifications: 1) hardware = A100-80GB? 2) include one run with continuous batching disabled for worst-case?

Maya (marketing): Yes A100-80GB. Please include the disabled-batching run. Also capture 5 sample completions per variant for QA. We9ll need a short blurb with the p95 by Friday morning.

Priya (runtime): Planned command (will run tonight):
```bash
redwood run-bench --model open-13b:v2 \
  --variants float16,q4_0,q4_k_m,int8 \
  --prompts marketing-100+product-20 \
  --concurrency 4,8,16 --warmup 2 \
  --collect p50,p95,p99,tokens_per_sec,gpu_util --tag marketing/webinar/quant-1791234567
```

Priya (runtime): We9ll upload csv + traces to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/quant-1791234567 and leave a README with methodology (batch window, kernel backend, seed). Will call out any tails or obvious quality regressions.

Ethan (sales): If numbers look favorable we9ll prep an inbound lead routing note for post-webinar followups. Please flag if any variant has notable quality drop (so sales doesn9t overpromise).

Priya (runtime): Runs started; small note: observed a p99 spike on q4_k_m at concurrency 16 during the cold run (KV eviction visible). Uploading logs now.
